title: Where the Qt6 renderer stands (v0.7.0, 15 Nov 2026)
summary: The latest branch is oodialog-qt6-v0.7, renderer v0.7.0, tested against oodialog-wasm fc16dfb (v0.15.0). All 39 of the suite's tests pass, both offscreen and on an X server (Xvfb with Qt's xcb platform, as a desktop runs it). The suite is the browser harness's tests, with their .steps and .expect files, plus the three programs the ooDialog Designer generates (Calculator, Contacts, Gadgets; see sphere oodialog-designer), used unchanged as a contract test. Every one of upstream's sample programs was also started with nothing clicked: against v0.15.0, 77 of 122 programs showed their dialog (75 against v0.14.0, 73 against v0.13.1). All 41 errors were in oodWeb.cls's scope; none was in the renderer: winsystm.cls 19, ooDialog native functions oodWeb does not have yet 11, no resource reader set 8, other 3. Earlier branches and their oodialog-wasm bases: v0.2 2c861d8, v0.3 23d57b2, v0.4 155e1b0, v0.5 1d89981, v0.6 0e0e744.
invariants: A pass count is only quoted with the oodialog-wasm commit it was run against and the platform (offscreen or xcb).
The sweep is a coverage check, not a test: a program that shows its dialog may still draw wrongly.
Not done yet: a run on a physical desktop with a window manager (KDE, GNOME); every X run so far was on Xvfb.

provenance.claim: 39 of 39 offscreen and on xcb against fc16dfb (v0.15.0).
